entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:1
segments: ¶He that is a eunuch, whether he have been crushed or cut, shall not come into the congregation of Jehovah.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:2
segments: A bastard shall not come into the congregation of Jehovah; even his tenth generation shall not come into the congregation of Jehovah.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:3
segments: An Ammonite or Moabite shall not come into the congregation of Jehovah; even their tenth generation shall not come into the congregation of Jehovah for ever;

entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:4
segments: because they met you not with bread and with water on the way, when ye came forth out of Egypt, and because they hired against thee Balaam the son of Beor, of Pethor of Mesopotamia, to curse thee.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:5
segments: But Jehovah thy God would not listen to Balaam; and Jehovah thy God turned the curse into blessing unto thee, because Jehovah thy God loved thee.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:6
segments: Thou shalt not seek their peace nor their prosperity all thy days for ever.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:7
segments: Thou shalt not abhor an Edomite; for he is thy brother. Thou shalt not abhor an Egyptian; because thou wast a sojourner in his land.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:8
segments: Children that are born to them shall come into the congregation of Jehovah in the third generation.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:9
segments: ¶When thou goest forth into camp against thine enemies, then keep thee from every evil thing.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:10
segments: If there be with thee a man that is not clean from what hath happened in the night, then shall he go outside the camp; he shall not come inside the camp;

entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:11
segments: and it shall be, towards evening, he shall bathe in water: and at the going down of the sun he may come inside the camp.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:12
segments: Thou shalt have a place also outside the camp, and shalt go forth thither.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:13
segments: And thou shalt have a shovel amongst thy weapons, and it shall be, when thou sittest down abroad, thou shalt dig therewith, and shalt turn back and cover that which is come from thee.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:14
segments: For Jehovah thy God walketh in the midst of thy camp, to deliver thee, and to give up thine enemies before thee; and thy camp shall be holy, that he see nothing unseemly with thee, and turn away from thee.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:15
segments: ¶Thou shalt not hand over to his master a bondman that hath escaped from his master unto thee:

entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:16
segments: he shall dwell with thee, even in thy midst, in the place that he shall choose in one of thy gates, where it seemeth good to him; thou shalt not oppress him.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:17
segments: There shall be no prostitute amongst the daughters of Israel, nor any Sodomite amongst the sons of Israel.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:18
segments: Thou shalt not bring the hire of a harlot, or the price of a dog, into the house of Jehovah thy God for any vow; for even both these are an abomination to Jehovah thy God.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:19
segments: Thou shalt take no interest of thy brother, interest of money, interest of victuals, interest of anything that can be lent upon interest:

entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:20
segments: of a foreigner thou mayest take interest, but of thy brother thou shalt not take interest; that Jehovah thy God may bless thee in all the business of thy hand in the land whither thou goest to possess it.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:21
segments: When thou vowest a vow to Jehovah thy God, thou shalt not delay to perform it; for Jehovah thy God will certainly require it of thee, and it shall be sin in thee.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:22
segments: But if thou forbear to vow, it shall be no sin in thee.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:23
segments: What is gone out of thy lips thou shalt keep and do, as thou hast vowed to Jehovah thy God, the voluntary-offering that thou hast promised with thy mouth.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:24
segments: When thou comest into thy neighbour's vineyard, thou mayest eat grapes thy fill, according to thy desire, but thou shalt not put any in thy vessel.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:25
segments: When thou comest into the standing corn of thy neighbour, thou mayest pluck ears with thy hand; but thou shalt not wave the sickle against thy neighbour's standing corn.
